# “e.l.f. Made to Stand Out”: e.l.f. Creates Handcrafted Holiday Campaign to Celebrate Self Expression, Individuality and Inclusivity

Nov 02,2026

*Narrated by Alan Cumming**,** e.l.f. shares a holiday tale for everyone who was never made to fit the mold*

OAKLAND, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- e.l.f. Brands, including e.l.f. Cosmetics, e.l.f. SKIN and e.l.f. Hair, part of e.l.f. Beauty (NYSE: ELF), is celebrating what makes every eye, lip and face one of a kind with “e.l.f. Made to Stand Out,” the brand’s first-ever holiday campaign. Created entirely through handmade stop-motion animation, marking another eyes.lips.first for e.l.f., the campaign puts an unmistakable e.l.f. twist on nostalgic holiday storytelling to celebrate a simple truth: your difference is lowkey your gift.

This press release features multimedia. View the full release here: [https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20261101541744/en/](https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20261101541744/en/)

![Alan Cumming narrates “e.l.f. Made to Stand Out,” e.l.f. Beauty’s first-ever holiday campaign celebrating individuality and the magic of embracing what makes you unique.](https://mms.businesswire.com/media/20261101541744/en/2953973/4/NJS_2162_copy.jpg)

Alan Cumming narrates “e.l.f. Made to Stand Out,” e.l.f. Beauty’s first-ever holiday campaign celebrating individuality and the magic of embracing what makes you unique.

Narrated by Emmy- and Tony Award-winning actor Alan Cumming, the campaign follows college-aged besties Kit, Echo and Cleo as they reunite in their hometown for the holidays and get ready for what could be an awkward night out. The trio, though, discovers that the qualities they've once questioned are actually the things that make them extraordinary.

“This campaign is an exciting e.l.f. first, and an opportunity to bring a uniquely e.l.f. point of view to the holiday season,” said Oshiya Savur, Chief Marketing Officer, e.l.f. Brands. “Just as no two handcrafted creations are exactly alike, it's our differences that make each of us one of a kind. We want our community to see themselves in these characters and feel something, so we created a world with as much personality as the people in it.”

Leaning into the charm of analog storytelling, the campaign brings a familiar tradition into the present with fresh imagination that celebrates human creativity and the joy of individuality. The creative choice is as intentional as the message itself:

- 72% of Americans saying nostalgic memories inspire them when life feels complicated*
- 68% of U.S. adults say nostalgia influences the products they purchase**

For e.l.f., embracing what makes us different isn't a seasonal message; it's an everyday commitment to celebrating individuality and inclusivity. e.l.f.’s high-quality, accessibly priced Holy Grail products put extra sparkle in the spot:

- Kit, the sentimental, nurturing presence holding the group together, preps with Power Grip Primer ($11)
- Echo, whose gift of gab knows no bounds, makes a statement with Glow Reviver Lip Oil ($9)
- Cleo, the bookish introvert with a talent all her own, gets her festive glow with Thirst Burst Drops ($13)

With his unmistakable Scottish voice and signature theatrical wit, **Alan Cumming** narrates the trio’s holiday adventure. “I do love a character with a little something extra, and Kit, Echo and Cleo each have plenty of that,” said **Cumming.** “What I love about this story is that their differences aren’t things to hide, they’re what make them special. Add in the incredible artistry of this handmade world, and it was a rather lovely holiday adventure to be part of.”

Directed by Cami Kwan, co-founder of Apartment D Films, the campaign is a deliberate celebration of analog artistry, where every playful detail is an example of hands-on craftsmanship. From individually molded characters to intricately constructed miniature sets, the production embraces the time-intensive process of traditional stop-motion animation, capturing the magic of a world built by hand, one frame at a time. In line with e.l.f.'s commitments to championing underrepresented artists and female empowerment, the production included women comprising 90% of the puppet team and 100% of the animation team.

**SHADOW,** a long-time creative marketing and communications agency partner to e.l.f. Beauty’s brands, led the campaign’s creative concept, script development and casting, working with Adam Goldman, Cumming's longtime collaborator, on the script.

The 60-second “e.l.f. Made to Stand Out” spot debuts November 2, 2026, across e.l.f. digital and social platforms. The holiday magic will extend beyond the screen and into the shopping aisle in a takeover of the TV sections of Best Buy and Target stores throughout the holiday gift-giving season.

Oct 20,2026

OAKLAND, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- e.l.f. Cosmetics, a brand from e.l.f. Beauty (NYSE: ELF) today announced a collaboration with Sanrio® to bring Kuromi™ into Glow Up!, e.l.f.’s immersive beauty experience on Roblox. Marking Kuromi’s first collaboration inside another brand on Roblox, the partnership brings together two kindred spirits known for bold disruption with a kind heart.

e.l.f. Cosmetics announces a collaboration with Sanrio® to bring Kuromi™ into Glow Up!, e.l.f.’s immersive beauty experience on Roblox.

Arriving just in time for Kuromi’s Halloween birthday and her annual Month of Mischief, the limited-time experience transforms Glow Up! with a dedicated Kuromi lobby, all-new whimsigoth looks and Kuromi-themed in-game items, with new content continuing through the holiday season.

The collaboration lands at a defining moment for Kuromi and e.l.f.’s growing presence in immersive gaming:

- Glow Up! is the no. 1 branded makeup game on Roblox, with more than 12 million visits since launch.
- e.l.f.’s Roblox experiences have generated more than 45 million visits overall, creating immersive spaces rooted in entrepreneurship, financial literacy and self-expression.

- Gaming is a defining part of how the next generation experiences culture. 90% of Gen Z and 94% of Gen Alpha engage with gaming through playing, viewing, owning or social behavior.

With Glow Up! on Roblox, we’ve created an immersive playground where creativity has no limits and everyone belongs. Bringing Kuromi into the e.l.f. universe is another unexpected way to surprise and delight our community, bringing together beauty, entertainment and self-expression in a way that is uniquely e.l.f.ing us,” said Patrick O’Keefe, Chief Integrated Marketing Officer, e.l.f. Brands.

- Glow from Halloween through the holidays: The experience debuts for Kuromi’s favorite season and evolves with new content throughout the holiday season, giving players new reasons to return, play and express themselves.

“Kuromi has always been about being true to yourself and celebrating your individuality,” said Jill Koch, Chief Brand Officer, Sanrio, Inc. “That spirit of self-expression makes e.l.f.’s Glow Up! on Roblox a natural fit, giving fans a playful new way to experiment with their personal style and express their creativity.”

e.l.f. collaborated with eGEN, a global immersive marketing consultancy, to develop the collaboration and bring the experience to life.

# “e.l.f. Made to Stand Out”: e.l.f. Creates Handcrafted Holiday Campaign to Celebrate Self Expression, Individuality and Inclusivity

Nov 02,2026

*Narrated by Alan Cumming**,** e.l.f. shares a holiday tale for everyone who was never made to fit the mold*

OAKLAND, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- e.l.f. Brands, including e.l.f. Cosmetics, e.l.f. SKIN and e.l.f. Hair, part of e.l.f. Beauty (NYSE: ELF), is celebrating what makes every eye, lip and face one of a kind with “e.l.f. Made to Stand Out,” the brand’s first-ever holiday campaign. Created entirely through handmade stop-motion animation, marking another eyes.lips.first for e.l.f., the campaign puts an unmistakable e.l.f. twist on nostalgic holiday storytelling to celebrate a simple truth: your difference is lowkey your gift.

This press release features multimedia. View the full release here: [https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20261101541744/en/](https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20261101541744/en/)

![Alan Cumming narrates “e.l.f. Made to Stand Out,” e.l.f. Beauty’s first-ever holiday campaign celebrating individuality and the magic of embracing what makes you unique.](https://mms.businesswire.com/media/20261101541744/en/2953973/4/NJS_2162_copy.jpg)

Alan Cumming narrates “e.l.f. Made to Stand Out,” e.l.f. Beauty’s first-ever holiday campaign celebrating individuality and the magic of embracing what makes you unique.

Narrated by Emmy- and Tony Award-winning actor Alan Cumming, the campaign follows college-aged besties Kit, Echo and Cleo as they reunite in their hometown for the holidays and get ready for what could be an awkward night out. The trio, though, discovers that the qualities they've once questioned are actually the things that make them extraordinary.

“This campaign is an exciting e.l.f. first, and an opportunity to bring a uniquely e.l.f. point of view to the holiday season,” said Oshiya Savur, Chief Marketing Officer, e.l.f. Brands. “Just as no two handcrafted creations are exactly alike, it's our differences that make each of us one of a kind. We want our community to see themselves in these characters and feel something, so we created a world with as much personality as the people in it.”

Leaning into the charm of analog storytelling, the campaign brings a familiar tradition into the present with fresh imagination that celebrates human creativity and the joy of individuality. The creative choice is as intentional as the message itself:

- 72% of Americans saying nostalgic memories inspire them when life feels complicated*
- 68% of U.S. adults say nostalgia influences the products they purchase**

For e.l.f., embracing what makes us different isn't a seasonal message; it's an everyday commitment to celebrating individuality and inclusivity. e.l.f.’s high-quality, accessibly priced Holy Grail products put extra sparkle in the spot:

- Kit, the sentimental, nurturing presence holding the group together, preps with Power Grip Primer ($11)
- Echo, whose gift of gab knows no bounds, makes a statement with Glow Reviver Lip Oil ($9)
- Cleo, the bookish introvert with a talent all her own, gets her festive glow with Thirst Burst Drops ($13)

With his unmistakable Scottish voice and signature theatrical wit, **Alan Cumming** narrates the trio’s holiday adventure. “I do love a character with a little something extra, and Kit, Echo and Cleo each have plenty of that,” said **Cumming.** “What I love about this story is that their differences aren’t things to hide, they’re what make them special. Add in the incredible artistry of this handmade world, and it was a rather lovely holiday adventure to be part of.”

Directed by Cami Kwan, co-founder of Apartment D Films, the campaign is a deliberate celebration of analog artistry, where every playful detail is an example of hands-on craftsmanship. From individually molded characters to intricately constructed miniature sets, the production embraces the time-intensive process of traditional stop-motion animation, capturing the magic of a world built by hand, one frame at a time. In line with e.l.f.'s commitments to championing underrepresented artists and female empowerment, the production included women comprising 90% of the puppet team and 100% of the animation team.

**SHADOW,** a long-time creative marketing and communications agency partner to e.l.f. Beauty’s brands, led the campaign’s creative concept, script development and casting, working with Adam Goldman, Cumming's longtime collaborator, on the script.

The 60-second “e.l.f. Made to Stand Out” spot debuts November 2, 2026, across e.l.f. digital and social platforms. The holiday magic will extend beyond the screen and into the shopping aisle in a takeover of the TV sections of Best Buy and Target stores throughout the holiday gift-giving season.

*The immersive experience enables players to discover, create and express themselves with e.l.f.-designed avatar looks*

- Predominantly female community and approximately 70% Gen Z

Nov 12,2026

e.l.f. Beauty Invites Community to Co-Create a Better World for Every Eye, Lip and Face

OAKLAND, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- e.l.f. Beauty (NYSE: ELF), a purpose-led, results-driven company, prioritizes its relationship with its community, adopting an operating model of Zero Distance to encourage and engage in open dialogue with every eye, lip and face. As the company publishes its fifth annual impact report for Fiscal Year 2026 today, e.l.f. Beauty moves closer to its community with the launch of “Dial 0 for Zero Distance,” an opportunity to interact directly with CEO and Chairman Tarang Amin.

Dial ‘0’ for Zero Distance: e.l.f. Beauty invites its community to connect directly with Chairman and CEO Tarang Amin, share the causes they care about and help shape the company's future impact.

Yes, a direct line. To the CEO. For kindred spirits to use and share what they care about.

That’s how e.l.f. Beauty shows up as a different kind of company by building brands that disrupt norms, shape culture and connect communities through positivity, inclusivity and accessibility. Zero Distance means just that: no daylight between insight and action; no daylight between the company and its community.

e.l.f. Beauty’s purpose is to make the world a better place for every eye, lip and face. Amin consistently emphasizes that e.l.f. Beauty cares about what its community cares about. That principle of Zero Distance mirrors the company’s approach to its business, prioritizing co-creating its disruptive brands and its high-quality, accessibly priced products with fans and followers.

Having just reported its 2Q Fiscal Year 2027 earnings results and the company’s 31st consecutive quarter of net-sales increases, Amin says how e.l.f. Beauty grows is as important as how much it grows.

“One of the things I have learned is that there’s always more to learn and more we can do. That is why Zero Distance is so important to us,” says Amin. “This impact report is Zero Distance in action. We want to spark conversations, awareness and, more importantly, meaningful action. Thank you to everyone in the community who cares about making the world a better place for every eye, lip and face. I hope to hear from you.”

Here’s how to join the conversation:

- Right now, the community can call or click a tap-to-dial online experience to learn more from Amin about e.l.f. Beauty’s purpose platform and leave a voicemail with feedback on the impact report and the causes they care about.

- On Thursday, November 19, 2026, from 10 am to 11 am Pacific Time, the community is invited to join an e.l.f. Beauty Town Hall, typically reserved for employees, through LinkedIn or Twitch. In the spirit of Zero Distance, it will be an inside-out look at the company culture that prioritizes High-Performance Teamwork, starting with the inspirational quote and collective stretching and breath work that begin every town hall. The agenda includes a share-out of the impact report with details from Amin, leaders of the company’s impact and sustainability teams, and purpose partners.

“I’m proud to share how we make a positive impact in the world while continuing to deliver strong business results. And we always strive to raise those bars,” Amin says.

- Advancing women’s health: The rhode Futures Fund made its deepest philanthropic commitment to the Foundation for Women’s Health. The [e.l.f. Cosmetics mobile app](https://www.elfcosmetics.com/pages/mobile-app) is a one-stop shop that makes clean beauty more accessible to every eye, lip and face. ## What is Beauty Squad?

Join the e.l.f. Beauty Squad! Our better-than-ever rewards and loyalty program lets you earn points for every dollar you spend on your favorite makeup and skincare products from e.l.f.

You can also score more points by completing tasks in the [e.l.f. app](https://www.elfcosmetics.com/pages/mobile-app) or website—from writing reviews, to connecting with us on social media, completing your beauty profile, uploading receipts, playing games and so much more. The best part? You can [redeem your loyalty rewards](https://www.elfcosmetics.com/pages/elf-beauty-squad) in exchange for products, offers, retailer gift cards and cash back.

## How can I earn more loyalty points through beauty brand programs by purchasing skincare & cosmetics?

Whether you're stocking up on skincare essentials or trying the latest makeup drops, Beauty Squad ensures every purchase brings you closer to rewards. If you're looking to earn more loyalty points, Beauty Squad makes it easy to get rewarded for every skincare and makeup purchase you make—no matter where you shop.

Earning loyalty points as a Beauty Squad member is simple—and there are multiple ways to maximize your rewards. Beauty Squad members earn 10 points for every dollar spent. As a member, you’ll also gain access to bonus point opportunities available during promotions, product launches, and limited-time events. ## Virtual Shade Finder Tool

A new tool is here with the e.l.f. Beauty App! Our new tool is here to help you find your perfect shade match. Available on mobile for iOS and Android, this shade finder tool uses the latest technology to scan your complexion in real time by taking a series of selfies that eliminate the effects of phone lighting impacting your color match.

Our shade finder is user-friendly, easy to navigate, and will give you the top 3 shade matches closest to your skin tone. The days of guesswork to try and find your perfect shade match are over—now you can find your exact shade in minutes thanks to our new virtual shade finder!

![](https://cdn.elfcosmetics.com/api/v1/image/assets%2F34401d5a4f21469a9be21fb9dc95e6a4%2F94a6100e137545c1b6c36b2e284dde02?width=100&quality=85&format=webp)

Here are some tips on how to use our shade matching tool:

1. Try to find the best natural lighting and avoid any bright light. Once you find your go-to lighting, make sure to wash off any existing makeup and remove glasses.
2. Center your face as best as you can in the oval on your screen. You can bring your phone closer to your face if needed. Remember to hold as still as you can while the screen flashes.
3. Avoid holding your fingers and thumbs over the display if possible.

Quick tip: Our shade finder will not work with privacy and blue-light screen protectors

## Our Virtual Try-On Tool

Treat yourself to a virtual makeover! Our beauty and makeup app’s try-on tool lets you virtually “test out” some of our best-selling makeup products in various shades before you buy them. It’s never been easier to discover your new favorite blush, find your best contour shade or pucker up to our lineup of lip products—all before you add to cart!

To customize your try-on experience, select an e.l.f.ing category (eyes, lips or face); next, choose if you want to create your makeup look live, on a model or with a photo of yourself. Then, let the fun begin! Tap the product you’d like to add to your look, and scroll through the shade offerings to find your best match.

Finally, you can add your favorite products to your bag and securely check out so you can rock them IRL.

## How to Play e.l.f. Blast

The e.l.f. Blast game offers Beauty Squad members a fun and easy way to earn points and unlock exclusive rewards. Players can match colorful makeup products into groups with power-ups inspired by e.l.f.'s iconic makeup products!

To begin playing, download the official e.l.f. Cosmetics app from the App Store or Google Play Store and create or log into your Beauty Squad account. Once logged in, navigate to the games section where you'll find e.l.f. Blast featured among the available arcade games. The gameplay is similar to popular match-three games, where you'll swipe cosmetic-themed icons to create matches of three or more identical items.

![](https://mms.businesswire.com/media/20261116893089/en/2973694/4/e.l.f._NWSL_Player_Roster.jpg)

Through its partnership with the NWSL and Football Co, e.l.f. is expanding visibility for women in sports, elevating the players and opening pathways for the next generation because the future of soccer belongs to empowered.legendary.females.

What was once overlooked is now one of the fastest-growing movements in global sport – creating new heroes, new communities and a new generation of fans. Through the first half of the season, the NWSL reported averaging a 10% increase year-over-year of fans per match and is currently on pace for a fourth consecutive season averaging more than 10,000 fans per match. e.l.f. entered the arena to celebrate women’s soccer by elevating the players’ voices and expanding its visibility and reach in the media and with the fans.

“Year one proved we belonged in the game, year two proves we can change the game – this is what happens when a brand shows up with purpose and stays,” said Patrick O’Keefe, Chief Integrated Marketing Officer, e.l.f. Brands. “Our partnership with the NWSL has always been about uplifting the overlooked, opening doors for the next generation and rewriting the rules of what’s possible on the field, which extends to the boardroom and beyond. When every fan can see their own possibility reflected back at them, we know we’re building something meant to last.”

e.l.f. did the research to show that “[Girls Who Play Change the Game](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.elfbeauty.com%2Fpdfs%2FelfBeauty_Parity_Report.pdf&esheet=54642442&newsitemid=20261116893089&lan=en-US&anchor=Girls+Who+Play+Change+the+Game&index=1&md5=4efc7bdae5903530318b7eadfc00653c).” In partnership with Parity, their recent research report – the largest and broadest study of its kind – shows how sports participation for girls creates a positive impact on the business leaders of tomorrow.

- Everyday Athletes* are nearly 50% more likely to hold leadership roles at work than women who played less or no sports.
- Everyday Athletes are 37% more likely to aspire to senior leadership and nearly 25% more likely to have negotiated their salary than women who played less or no sports.
- 69% of Everyday Athletes who have worked at least five years say the lessons they learned in sports are more important than ever in today’s workplace.

e.l.f.’s partnership with the NWSL celebrates the players, fans and communities shaping the future of soccer. Here’s how e.l.f. is showing up for every eye, lip and face at the **2026 NWSL Championship, presented by Google Pixel.**

This year, e.l.f. partnered with Rush Soccer’s network of 25,000+ girls and women players to scale its [**Glow For Glory contest**](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestor.elfbeauty.com%2Fstock-and-financial%2Fpress-releases%2Flanding-news%2F2025%2F09-15-2025-050116409&esheet=54642442&newsitemid=20261116893089&lan=en-US&anchor=Glow+For+Glory+contest&index=2&md5=8424bfb373615772ee9d57c7712902bf), and show up in more locations to drive increased impact. Following over 1,200 submissions from 13–18-year-old girls across the U.S., five finalists were selected and will travel to the 2026 NWSL Championship, presented by Google Pixel, for a chance to be crowned the 2026 Glow For Glory winner. The five Glow For Glory finalists will collect the official Championship Match Ball and travel approximately 250 miles with it from New York to Washington, D.C. with pit stops along the way to meet one of the NWSL players on e.l.f.’s roster and experience an e.l.f. shopping spree at CVS Pharmacy, an Official Health & Wellness Partner of the NWSL.

**The March to the Match**, presented by e.l.f., will be led by the Washington Commanders’ 50-member marching band and drumline, branded in e.l.f. gear alongside dancers and the Glow For Glory finalists, the march will transform the journey to the stadium into a celebration of women's soccer.

**NWSL Fan Fest** is a celebration of the game, bringing fans of all ages together through interactive experiences, sponsor activations, live entertainment, food and unforgettable moments beyond the pitch.

All season long, e.l.f. has activated a connected commerce ecosystem across Amazon, TikTok Live, and social platforms like Glow Up!, e.l.f.’s Roblox makeup experience, converting NWSL moments into real-time sales.

e.l.f. supports a roster of NWSL players who are shaping the future of the game on and off the field: Ally Sentnor (Angel City FC), Jaedyn Shaw (Gotham FC), Jess Carter (Gotham FC) and Lo’eau LaBonta (Kansas City Current), who will be competing in the Championship game this week. These are the players redefining what’s e.l.f.ing possible and e.l.f. is proud to be in their corner.

e.l.f.’s commitment extends far beyond the soccer field. Through e.l.f.’s empowering.legendary.females. initiative, e.l.f. stands with girls and women athletes across sports and is breaking barriers and rewriting the rules of the game because legendary females are not limited to just one arena. e.l.f.’s player roster spans icons and rising stars alike, including Billie Jean King, Katherine Legge, Flau’jae Johnson and Kendall Coyne, and extends across sports and leagues, including PWHL and Wonder Women Wrestling. From the rink to the ring to the field, e.l.f. is here for every eye, lip and face.

# e.l.f. Brands Hits the Pitch for Year Two with Tottenham Hotspur Women

Oct 13,2026

*e.l.f. returns as Official Back of Shirt Sponsor for the 2026-2027 season, building on its commitment to empower.legendary.females.*

LONDON--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- e.l.f. Brands, part of e.l.f. Beauty (NYSE: ELF), includes e.l.f. Cosmetics, e.l.f. SKIN and e.l.f. Hair, announces the continuation of its partnership with Tottenham Hotspur Women as the Official Back of Shirt Sponsor, coming off of the Women’s team’s most successful season in WSL history.

This press release features multimedia. View the full release here: [https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20261013525570/en/](https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20261013525570/en/)

![e.l.f. sponsors Tottenham Hotspur Women for 2026-2027 season.](https://mms.businesswire.com/media/20261013525570/en/2932858/4/img-4755faa5-ba1b-4c70-ad5c-485a519520a4.jpg)

e.l.f. sponsors Tottenham Hotspur Women for 2026-2027 season.

e.l.f. and Tottenham Hotspur Women are united by a shared ambition: to champion the growth and visibility of women’s football, creating wider access to sport and accelerating pathways for the next generation of leaders.

Last season, e.l.f. created a surprise and delight moment for 180 young girl footballers, giving them the opportunity of a lifetime to meet two Spurs players and former captain and Hall of Famer, Jenna Schillaci. They focused on developing the skills learned on the pitch and how they can apply them to later become successful women leaders in the workforce.

That field exercise complements the broader research e.l.f. released earlier this week in the report, [“Girls Who Play Change the Game”](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.elfbeauty.com%2Fpdfs%2FelfBeauty_Parity_Report.pdf&esheet=54621330&newsitemid=20261013525570&lan=en-US&anchor=%26%238220%3BGirls+Who+Play+Change+the+Game%26%238221%3B&index=1&md5=35ee075da6ce7695acc2e5bc17ec982d). Conducted in partnership with [Parity](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.paritynow.com%2F&esheet=54621330&newsitemid=20261013525570&lan=en-US&anchor=Parity&index=2&md5=f2eafbb0ec3983afcafdb1efa41b339f), the study draws on more than 9,500 respondents across the UK, US, Canada and Germany, making it one of the largest and broadest studies of its kind. The study reveals 95% of Everyday Athletes* say they learned at least one professional skill through sport, with the most common skills learned that support them in their careers being teamwork, performing under pressure, communication, discipline, perseverance and adaptability.

The study demonstrated Everyday Athletes are nearly 50% more likely to hold leadership roles at work. That’s why e.l.f. is doubling down on keeping girls in the game and opening doors from the locker room to the boardroom.

“We’re proud to continue our partnership with Tottenham Hotspur Women to force multiply visibility, access and opportunity for women in sports. Together, we’re using our loudspeaker to champion these incredible athletes, connect communities and help change the game for the next generation,” said Patrick O’Keefe, Chief Integrated Marketing Officer, e.l.f. Brands.

“Too many girls leave sports just as they’re building the skills that can shape their futures. Our research shows Everyday Athletes are nearly 50% more likely to hold leadership roles at work—and in the UK, 36% more likely to have negotiated their salary, the biggest gap of any country we studied. We want to disrupt that trajectory by keeping girls in the game, democratizing access to the playing field and opening more doors from the locker room to the boardroom.”

“Our partnership with e.l.f. brings together two disruptors in their respective spaces, united by a shared ambition to challenge convention and drive the women’s game forward,” said Ryan Norys, Chief Revenue Officer, Tottenham Hotspur. “The first year of the partnership was underlined by the progress of our Women’s team on the pitch, and together we will continue to champion the women’s game and create unmatched experiences for our supporters.”

Throughout the 2026-2027 season, Tottenham Hotspur Women and e.l.f. will continue to deliver unique experiences, innovative content and community initiatives.

Tottenham Hotspur Women is part of a long list of e.l.f.’s empowering.legendary.female. partnerships from leagues including National Women’s Soccer League (NWSL) and the Professional Women’s Hockey League (PWHL) to athletes including Billie Jean King, NWSL player, Jess Carter and professional race car driver Katherine Legge.

*Building on the success of its Minnesota State Fair debut, e.l.f. continues to meet its community where they are and join the fun*

OAKLAND, Calif.--([BUSINESS WIRE](https://www.businesswire.com))--e.l.f. Brands, including e.l.f. Cosmetics, e.l.f. SKIN and e.l.f. Hair, part of e.l.f. Beauty (NYSE: ELF), is taking eyes.lips.fairgrounds. south. Building upon its success from its first-ever state fair activation at the Minnesota State Fair in August, e.l.f. is bringing its surprise and delight experience to the State Fair of Texas – once again showing up where no other beauty brand is to meet its community.

State fairs are more than rides, games and food: they are places where communities of all generations come together to connect through shared traditions. And that is exactly where e.l.f. wants to be.

The State Fair of Texas has been bringing people together for 140 years, and last year more than 2 million people attended across its 24 days of entertainment, tradition and community.

Amplifying the enthusiastic signals received in Minnesota, e.l.f. is producing its pickle-themed activation in Dallas. Alongside the famous Big Tex icon, the brand will have boots on the ground creating meaningful connections and gifting e.l.f. products, of course.

In Minnesota, more than 64K people passed through e.l.f.’s activation and the average guest at the e.l.f. activation spent 8 minutes getting to know how the brand shows up as a different kind of company.

From Friday, October 9, through Sunday, October 11, e.l.f. will have its larger-than-life pickle jar activation inspired by e.l.f. Cosmetics’ pickle-inspired Glow Reviver Melting Lip Balms and will debut its Texas-tall Suntouchable Invisi-Stick. Fairgoers can expect product gifting across e.l.f. Brands, including e.l.f. Cosmetics, e.l.f. SKIN and e.l.f. Hair, while supplies last.

“At e.l.f., we don’t wait for our community to come to us; we go where they are. We saw the signals to lean into state fairs and the Minnesota State Fair reinforced something we always believed: some of the most impactful moments happen when you show up somewhere unexpected and simply connect on a deeper level,” said Patrick O’Keefe, Chief Integrated Marketing Officer of e.l.f. Brands. “Minnesota was beyond our expectations, and we are bringing that spirit to Texas. Beauty belongs everywhere and there is nothing more impactful than serving our community in the places they least expect us.”

eyes.lips.fairgrounds. is part of e.l.f.’s continued commitment to meeting their community where they are through meaningful connections: 95% of fairgoers say they attend to socialize and connect**. e.l.f. sees IRL experiences as an essential complement to its global digital footprint to build brand affinity while surprising and delighting the community. With no other beauty brand showing up at the state fair, it presents an unexpected footprint with meaningful impact.

# “e.l.f. Made to Stand Out”: e.l.f. Creates Handcrafted Holiday Campaign to Celebrate Self Expression, Individuality and Inclusivity

Nov 02,2026

*Narrated by Alan Cumming**,** e.l.f. shares a holiday tale for everyone who was never made to fit the mold*

OAKLAND, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- e.l.f. Brands, including e.l.f. Cosmetics, e.l.f. SKIN and e.l.f. Hair, part of e.l.f. Beauty (NYSE: ELF), is celebrating what makes every eye, lip and face one of a kind with “e.l.f. Made to Stand Out,” the brand’s first-ever holiday campaign. Created entirely through handmade stop-motion animation, marking another eyes.lips.first for e.l.f., the campaign puts an unmistakable e.l.f. twist on nostalgic holiday storytelling to celebrate a simple truth: your difference is lowkey your gift.

This press release features multimedia. View the full release here: [https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20261101541744/en/](https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20261101541744/en/)

![Alan Cumming narrates “e.l.f. Made to Stand Out,” e.l.f. Beauty’s first-ever holiday campaign celebrating individuality and the magic of embracing what makes you unique.](https://mms.businesswire.com/media/20261101541744/en/2953973/4/NJS_2162_copy.jpg)

Alan Cumming narrates “e.l.f. Made to Stand Out,” e.l.f. Beauty’s first-ever holiday campaign celebrating individuality and the magic of embracing what makes you unique.

Narrated by Emmy- and Tony Award-winning actor Alan Cumming, the campaign follows college-aged besties Kit, Echo and Cleo as they reunite in their hometown for the holidays and get ready for what could be an awkward night out. The trio, though, discovers that the qualities they've once questioned are actually the things that make them extraordinary.

“This campaign is an exciting e.l.f. first, and an opportunity to bring a uniquely e.l.f. point of view to the holiday season,” said Oshiya Savur, Chief Marketing Officer, e.l.f. Brands. “Just as no two handcrafted creations are exactly alike, it's our differences that make each of us one of a kind. We want our community to see themselves in these characters and feel something, so we created a world with as much personality as the people in it.”

Leaning into the charm of analog storytelling, the campaign brings a familiar tradition into the present with fresh imagination that celebrates human creativity and the joy of individuality. The creative choice is as intentional as the message itself:

- 72% of Americans saying nostalgic memories inspire them when life feels complicated*
- 68% of U.S. adults say nostalgia influences the products they purchase**

For e.l.f., embracing what makes us different isn't a seasonal message; it's an everyday commitment to celebrating individuality and inclusivity. e.l.f.’s high-quality, accessibly priced Holy Grail products put extra sparkle in the spot:

- Kit, the sentimental, nurturing presence holding the group together, preps with Power Grip Primer ($11)
- Echo, whose gift of gab knows no bounds, makes a statement with Glow Reviver Lip Oil ($9)
- Cleo, the bookish introvert with a talent all her own, gets her festive glow with Thirst Burst Drops ($13)

With his unmistakable Scottish voice and signature theatrical wit, **Alan Cumming** narrates the trio’s holiday adventure. “I do love a character with a little something extra, and Kit, Echo and Cleo each have plenty of that,” said **Cumming.** “What I love about this story is that their differences aren’t things to hide, they’re what make them special. Add in the incredible artistry of this handmade world, and it was a rather lovely holiday adventure to be part of.”

Directed by Cami Kwan, co-founder of Apartment D Films, the campaign is a deliberate celebration of analog artistry, where every playful detail is an example of hands-on craftsmanship. From individually molded characters to intricately constructed miniature sets, the production embraces the time-intensive process of traditional stop-motion animation, capturing the magic of a world built by hand, one frame at a time. In line with e.l.f.'s commitments to championing underrepresented artists and female empowerment, the production included women comprising 90% of the puppet team and 100% of the animation team.

**SHADOW,** a long-time creative marketing and communications agency partner to e.l.f. Beauty’s brands, led the campaign’s creative concept, script development and casting, working with Adam Goldman, Cumming's longtime collaborator, on the script.

The 60-second “e.l.f. Made to Stand Out” spot debuts November 2, 2026, across e.l.f. digital and social platforms. The holiday magic will extend beyond the screen and into the shopping aisle in a takeover of the TV sections of Best Buy and Target stores throughout the holiday gift-giving season.

e.l.f. POP transports e.l.f.'s community to sensorial destinations, starting with an arctic-inspired holiday launch

- **New category expansion:** e.l.f. Brands (e.l.f. Beauty, NYSE: ELF) is entering fragrance and body care for the first time with the launch of e.l.f. POP, a destination-inspired collection.

- **First drop — Tromsø, Norway:** The debut limited-edition holiday collection features the "Spicy Bundt Nice" gourmand fragrance with notes of holiday spice cake, orange zest, cardamom, butter cream frosting, cedarwood, and warm musk.

- **Accessible pricing & SKUs:** Three products — fragrance mist ($13), silky body cream ($13), and a travel-size kit ($12) — continuing e.l.f.'s affordable, vegan, cruelty-free (Leaping Bunny & PETA certified) positioning.

- **Availability & rollout:** Launched on TikTok Shop US (Oct 4, 2026), then elfcosmetics.com, elfcosmetics.co.uk, TikTok Shop UK/Germany (Oct 5), and Amazon US/UK/DE/CA (Oct 6). The campaign features Norwegian illustrator Esra Røise and pop artist SKAAR

  e.l.f. Brands, including of e.l.f. Cosmetics, e.l.f. SKIN and e.l.f. Hair, part of e.l.f. Beauty (NYSE: ELF), is making its move into fragrance and body care with the launch of e.l.f. POP, a new collection that transports consumers to sensorial destinations through signature scents. The category expansions debut with e.l.f. POP: Tromsø, a limited-edition holiday drop featuring “Spicy Bundt Nice” fragrance inspired by the wintery wonders of Norway.

The comprehensive e.l.f. POP lineup, featuring additional destination scents, will be released in January 2027.

Highlighting e.l.f. Brands’ elasticity to meet the community where they are, the debut of e.l.f. POP exemplifies e.l.f.’s approach to listening, learning and leaning in. The e.l.f. POP name is an ode to e.l.f. Cosmetics’ Jelly Pop, a limited-edition mini collection and one of the brand’s first community-loved scents. e.l.f. continued to embrace community signals in the category with the limited-edition fragrance collab earlier this year with H&M. Fragrance is the fastest growing beauty category globally*, and 42% of fragrance wearers who look for scents to evoke mood or emotion when purchasing**.

Meeting the holiday season with a hot drop fueled by wintertime favorites, Tromsø is the first stop on e.l.f. POP’s globetrotting journey. Tromsø, Norway, where the winter sky ignites with the Northern lights, is in every sense a quintessential holiday destination. e.l.f. POP: Tromsø’s fragrance “Spicy Bundt Nice” captures those sensorial vibes with notes of holiday spice cake, orange zest, cardamom, butter cream frosting, cedarwood and warm musk. The spicy gourmand limited-edition e.l.f. POP: Tromsø collection includes three SKUs, all priced accessibly: fragrance mist ($13), silky body cream ($13) and a travel-size kit ($12).

e.l.f. partnered with two Norwegian artists to create a holistic, transporting experience across the Tromsø collection’s packaging and supporting campaign. Illustrator Esra Røise anchors the collection’s visuals across the product line. Pop artist SKAAR created the soundtrack for the launch assets.

“e.l.f. POP is our next bold leap as we stretch into new playgrounds and categories. Fragrance is a unique form of self-expression; it is personal and customizable. Body care transforms an everyday necessity into a ritual of self-care and indulgence. Each intentionally selected destination in the e.l.f. POP collection is designed to transport you somewhere you want to be – to make you feel something personal and special,” said Oshiya Savur, Chief Marketing Officer of e.l.f. Brands. “Our destinations are a connective throughline to our community, they guided our flight path to locations that inspired the collection. It is rooted in pride and place, the power of people, which we feel is the true essence of e.l.f. POP.”

The e.l.f. POP: Tromsø collection launched on TikTok Shop US on October 4, 2026, during “Fall Deals for You Days,” and is available on elfcosmetics.com, elfcosmetics.co.uk, TikTok Shop UK and TikTok Shop Germany starting today, October 5, 2026. The collection will also be available on Amazon (US/UK/DE/CA) on October 6, 2026.

OAKLAND, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Well People, the award-winning, high-performance clean beauty brand powered by plants from e.l.f. Beauty (NYSE: ELF), today announced its launch at Sprouts Farmers Market. Beginning today, November 9, a curated assortment of Well People cosmetics and skin care will be available in more than 500 Sprouts stores nationwide and on [Sprouts.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.sprouts.com%2F&esheet=54637863&newsitemid=20261108255725&lan=en-US&anchor=Sprouts.com&index=1&md5=3c31e9040880eeeae2e4500963cd8342), bringing clean beauty into the wellness routines of Sprouts shoppers across the country.

This press release features multimedia. View the full release here: [https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20261108255725/en/](https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20261108255725/en/)

![Well People brings its clean, plant-powered beauty essentials to Sprouts Farmers Market nationwide.](https://mms.businesswire.com/media/20261108255725/en/2963823/4/1126_Well_People_SPROUTS_16x9.jpg)

Well People brings its clean, plant-powered beauty essentials to Sprouts Farmers Market nationwide.

For nearly two decades, Well People has been creating high-performance, clean cosmetics and skin care powered by plants — long before it was cool. The expansion into Sprouts brings together two brands with a shared commitment to clean ingredients, transparency and wellness for the whole self, making it easier for consumers to bring the same consideration to what goes on their skin as what goes in their bodies.

“When we started Well People, we believed clean beauty belonged in the same conversation as clean eating and clean living,” said Shirley Pinkson Mañas, Well People Co-Founder. “Today, clean beauty isn't a niche, it's the new standard. Sprouts has long been a trusted destination for mindful living, and now its community can shop their makeup and skincare with the same confidence they bring to the rest of their wellness routine — without compromising on performance or paying a premium for peace of mind.”

Well People is the color cosmetics brand with the most Environmental Working Group (EWG) VERIFIED® products in the industry, with more than 100 products meeting EWG’s rigorous standards for health, transparency and safety. The brand is also the first and only cosmetics brand with the Sorette Seal of Approval for Motherhood, with Well People essentials reviewed against Sorette’s science-backed product standards to help moms navigate product choices with greater clarity.

That commitment has particular relevance for the Sprouts community, including new and expecting moms seeking clean, accessible products as part of their broader wellness routines. Well People products are clean and vegan, pregnancy-friendly, dermatologist-developed and double-certified by Leaping Bunny and PETA as cruelty free, with formulas made without more than 2,500 ingredients. The brand is also proud to have products made in Fair Trade Certified™ facilities.

Accessibility has been core to Well People since its founding. The brand’s full assortment is priced at $30 and under, and the assortment available at Sprouts ranges from $12 to $26, giving shoppers another way to discover high-performance clean beauty without paying a premium.

The partnership comes as beauty and wellness routines continue to converge, with grocery now representing the second-largest beauty sales channel globally. For Sprouts shoppers already paying close attention to ingredients, sourcing and wellness as they fill their grocery carts, Well People makes it possible to bring those same standards into their beauty routines.

Available in the Beauty & Wellness aisle of the Vitamins & Body Care department the curated assortment spans skin care, eye, cheek and lip essentials, including Well People’s Juice Cleanse Soothing Aloe Face Cleanser, Fresh Dew Snow Mushroom Gel-Cream Moisturizer, Daygleamer Mineral Sunscreen Serum SPF 34, Expressionist eye and brow essentials, Poutlove Peptide Lip Balm and Lush Lip Tinted Oil.

The chain-wide rollout brings Well People to more than 500 Sprouts locations, making clean beauty easy to discover as part of the weekly grocery and wellness shop. Well People products will be available beginning November 3 at Sprouts Farmers Market locations nationwide and on [Sprouts.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.sprouts.com%2F&esheet=54637863&newsitemid=20261108255725&lan=en-US&anchor=Sprouts.com&index=2&md5=21a8709bd224a720eb7ca68188f12fbd).

# “e.l.f. Made to Stand Out”: e.l.f. Creates Handcrafted Holiday Campaign to Celebrate Self Expression, Individuality and Inclusivity

Nov 02,2026

*Narrated by Alan Cumming**,** e.l.f. shares a holiday tale for everyone who was never made to fit the mold*

OAKLAND, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- e.l.f. Brands, including e.l.f. Cosmetics, e.l.f. SKIN and e.l.f. Hair, part of e.l.f. Beauty (NYSE: ELF), is celebrating what makes every eye, lip and face one of a kind with “e.l.f. Made to Stand Out,” the brand’s first-ever holiday campaign. Created entirely through handmade stop-motion animation, marking another eyes.lips.first for e.l.f., the campaign puts an unmistakable e.l.f. twist on nostalgic holiday storytelling to celebrate a simple truth: your difference is lowkey your gift.

This press release features multimedia. View the full release here: [https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20261101541744/en/](https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20261101541744/en/)

![Alan Cumming narrates “e.l.f. Made to Stand Out,” e.l.f. Beauty’s first-ever holiday campaign celebrating individuality and the magic of embracing what makes you unique.](https://mms.businesswire.com/media/20261101541744/en/2953973/4/NJS_2162_copy.jpg)

Alan Cumming narrates “e.l.f. Made to Stand Out,” e.l.f. Beauty’s first-ever holiday campaign celebrating individuality and the magic of embracing what makes you unique.

Narrated by Emmy- and Tony Award-winning actor Alan Cumming, the campaign follows college-aged besties Kit, Echo and Cleo as they reunite in their hometown for the holidays and get ready for what could be an awkward night out. The trio, though, discovers that the qualities they've once questioned are actually the things that make them extraordinary.

“This campaign is an exciting e.l.f. first, and an opportunity to bring a uniquely e.l.f. point of view to the holiday season,” said Oshiya Savur, Chief Marketing Officer, e.l.f. Brands. “Just as no two handcrafted creations are exactly alike, it's our differences that make each of us one of a kind. We want our community to see themselves in these characters and feel something, so we created a world with as much personality as the people in it.”

Leaning into the charm of analog storytelling, the campaign brings a familiar tradition into the present with fresh imagination that celebrates human creativity and the joy of individuality. The creative choice is as intentional as the message itself:

- 72% of Americans saying nostalgic memories inspire them when life feels complicated*
- 68% of U.S. adults say nostalgia influences the products they purchase**

For e.l.f., embracing what makes us different isn't a seasonal message; it's an everyday commitment to celebrating individuality and inclusivity. e.l.f.’s high-quality, accessibly priced Holy Grail products put extra sparkle in the spot:

- Kit, the sentimental, nurturing presence holding the group together, preps with Power Grip Primer ($11)
- Echo, whose gift of gab knows no bounds, makes a statement with Glow Reviver Lip Oil ($9)
- Cleo, the bookish introvert with a talent all her own, gets her festive glow with Thirst Burst Drops ($13)

With his unmistakable Scottish voice and signature theatrical wit, **Alan Cumming** narrates the trio’s holiday adventure. “I do love a character with a little something extra, and Kit, Echo and Cleo each have plenty of that,” said **Cumming.** “What I love about this story is that their differences aren’t things to hide, they’re what make them special. Add in the incredible artistry of this handmade world, and it was a rather lovely holiday adventure to be part of.”

Directed by Cami Kwan, co-founder of Apartment D Films, the campaign is a deliberate celebration of analog artistry, where every playful detail is an example of hands-on craftsmanship. From individually molded characters to intricately constructed miniature sets, the production embraces the time-intensive process of traditional stop-motion animation, capturing the magic of a world built by hand, one frame at a time. In line with e.l.f.'s commitments to championing underrepresented artists and female empowerment, the production included women comprising 90% of the puppet team and 100% of the animation team.

**SHADOW,** a long-time creative marketing and communications agency partner to e.l.f. Beauty’s brands, led the campaign’s creative concept, script development and casting, working with Adam Goldman, Cumming's longtime collaborator, on the script.

The 60-second “e.l.f. Made to Stand Out” spot debuts November 2, 2026, across e.l.f. digital and social platforms. The holiday magic will extend beyond the screen and into the shopping aisle in a takeover of the TV sections of Best Buy and Target stores throughout the holiday gift-giving season.

# e.l.f. Beauty Launches ‘Dial 0 for Zero Distance’ - a Direct Hotline to CEO Tarang Amin - to Highlight Fifth Annual Impact Report

Nov 12,2026

e.l.f. Beauty Invites Community to Co-Create a Better World for Every Eye, Lip and Face

OAKLAND, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- e.l.f. Beauty (NYSE: ELF), a purpose-led, results-driven company, prioritizes its relationship with its community, adopting an operating model of Zero Distance to encourage and engage in open dialogue with every eye, lip and face. As the company publishes its fifth annual impact report for Fiscal Year 2026 today, e.l.f. Beauty moves closer to its community with the launch of “Dial 0 for Zero Distance,” an opportunity to interact directly with CEO and Chairman Tarang Amin.

This press release features multimedia. View the full release here: [https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20261111572259/en/](https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20261111572259/en/)

![Dial ‘0’ for Zero Distance: e.l.f. Beauty invites its community to connect directly with Chairman and CEO Tarang Amin, share the causes they care about and help shape the company's future impact.](https://mms.businesswire.com/media/20261111572259/en/2968476/4/ZeroDistance_Dial0_1920x1080.jpg)

Dial ‘0’ for Zero Distance: e.l.f. Beauty invites its community to connect directly with Chairman and CEO Tarang Amin, share the causes they care about and help shape the company's future impact.

Yes, a direct line. To the CEO. For kindred spirits to use and share what they care about.

That’s how e.l.f. Beauty shows up as a different kind of company by building brands that disrupt norms, shape culture and connect communities through positivity, inclusivity and accessibility. Zero Distance means just that: no daylight between insight and action; no daylight between the company and its community.

e.l.f. Beauty’s purpose is to make the world a better place for every eye, lip and face. Amin consistently emphasizes that e.l.f. Beauty cares about what its community cares about. That principle of Zero Distance mirrors the company’s approach to its business, prioritizing co-creating its disruptive brands and its high-quality, accessibly priced products with fans and followers.

Having just reported its 2Q Fiscal Year 2027 earnings results and the company’s 31st consecutive quarter of net-sales increases, Amin says how e.l.f. Beauty grows is as important as how much it grows.

“One of the things I have learned is that there’s always more to learn and more we can do. That is why Zero Distance is so important to us,” says Amin. “This impact report is Zero Distance in action. We want to spark conversations, awareness and, more importantly, meaningful action. Thank you to everyone in the community who cares about making the world a better place for every eye, lip and face. I hope to hear from you.”

Here’s how to join the conversation:

- Right now, the community can call or click a tap-to-dial online experience to learn more from Amin about e.l.f. Beauty’s purpose platform and leave a voicemail with feedback on the impact report and the causes they care about.
- On Friday, November 13, 2026, from 9 am to 12 pm Pacific Time, Amin will host a live call-in session for one-to-one conversations with the community about the impact report and the always-on work e.l.f. Beauty does to encourage self-expression, embody our ethics and empower others.
- On Thursday, November 19, 2026, from 10 am to 11 am Pacific Time, the community is invited to join an e.l.f. Beauty Town Hall, typically reserved for employees, through LinkedIn or Twitch. In the spirit of Zero Distance, it will be an inside-out look at the company culture that prioritizes High-Performance Teamwork, starting with the inspirational quote and collective stretching and breath work that begin every town hall. The agenda includes a share-out of the impact report with details from Amin, leaders of the company’s impact and sustainability teams, and purpose partners.

“I’m proud to share how we make a positive impact in the world while continuing to deliver strong business results. And we always strive to raise those bars,” Amin says.

Key initiative highlights from the latest impact report, now available on [www.elfbeauty.com/impact](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.elfbeauty.com%2Fimpact&esheet=54640070&newsitemid=20261111572259&lan=en-US&anchor=www.elfbeauty.com%2Fimpact&index=1&md5=b70d1d8669ddd9070506725e8ed9293c), include:

- Change the Board Game: With a Board of Directors that puts e.l.f. Beauty among the top 1% of publicly traded U.S. companies for board diversity, this is e.l.f. Beauty’s purpose initiative celebrating positivity, inclusivity and accessibility. It aims to increase the number of women and people of color on U.S. public company boards. More than 500 like-minded organizations, individuals and companies joined the e.l.f.-led coalition; and 58% of graduates from the e.l.f. Beauty-supported board readiness program from the National Association of Corporate Directors have been placed on boards
- Fair Trade: e.l.f. Beauty was the first beauty company with Fair Trade Certified manufacturing facilities. e.l.f. Beauty Fair Trade Community Development Fund supported worker-led initiatives across community, healthcare, housing and transportation, touching 1,600+ people
- Empowering legendary females: e.l.f. Brands supports the power of sports to build confidence and develop future leaders. e.l.f., working with Parity, prepared an international report that found women who play sports growing up are nearly 50% more likely to hold leadership roles at work than women who played little or no sports
- Advancing women’s health: The rhode Futures Fund made its deepest philanthropic commitment to the Foundation for Women’s Health. The $5 million investment over three years supports rhode founder Hailey Bieber’s passion to bring greater awareness and more impactful research to an area that has been historically underfunded
- Co-creating global impact with the next generation: e.l.f. Beauty partnered with RIVET across the UK and India to fuel Zero Limits, a youth-led, community-driven initiative to expand access to funding, training and mentorship. Through the initial phase, 100 changemakers will turn local ideas into real-world solutions
- Supporting kind hearts: e.l.f. Beauty donates more than 2% of net profits to causes the community cares about each year, totaling more than $4 million in Fiscal Year 26. The company also matches all employee contributions during its annual holiday match program and Amin and his wife, Hirni, personally match those donations, too. The impact reached more than 200 non-profit organizations
- Clean electricity: e.l.f. Beauty has made a commitment by its brands to source 50% clean electricity across their manufacturing suppliers by March 31, 2032. Use of clean energy across e.l.f.’s brands’ direct suppliers has grown from 2% in Fiscal Year 23 to 14% in Fiscal Year 26, driven by supplier investments

e.l.f. Beauty’s mantra is: Anything is e.l.f.ing possible.

# “e.l.f. Made to Stand Out”: e.l.f. Creates Handcrafted Holiday Campaign to Celebrate Self Expression, Individuality and Inclusivity

Nov 02,2026

*Narrated by Alan Cumming**,** e.l.f. shares a holiday tale for everyone who was never made to fit the mold*

OAKLAND, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- e.l.f. Brands, including e.l.f. Cosmetics, e.l.f. SKIN and e.l.f. Hair, part of e.l.f. Beauty (NYSE: ELF), is celebrating what makes every eye, lip and face one of a kind with “e.l.f. Made to Stand Out,” the brand’s first-ever holiday campaign. Created entirely through handmade stop-motion animation, marking another eyes.lips.first for e.l.f., the campaign puts an unmistakable e.l.f. twist on nostalgic holiday storytelling to celebrate a simple truth: your difference is lowkey your gift.

This press release features multimedia. View the full release here: [https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20261101541744/en/](https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20261101541744/en/)

![Alan Cumming narrates “e.l.f. Made to Stand Out,” e.l.f. Beauty’s first-ever holiday campaign celebrating individuality and the magic of embracing what makes you unique.](https://mms.businesswire.com/media/20261101541744/en/2953973/4/NJS_2162_copy.jpg)

Alan Cumming narrates “e.l.f. Made to Stand Out,” e.l.f. Beauty’s first-ever holiday campaign celebrating individuality and the magic of embracing what makes you unique.

Narrated by Emmy- and Tony Award-winning actor Alan Cumming, the campaign follows college-aged besties Kit, Echo and Cleo as they reunite in their hometown for the holidays and get ready for what could be an awkward night out. The trio, though, discovers that the qualities they've once questioned are actually the things that make them extraordinary.

“This campaign is an exciting e.l.f. first, and an opportunity to bring a uniquely e.l.f. point of view to the holiday season,” said Oshiya Savur, Chief Marketing Officer, e.l.f. Brands. “Just as no two handcrafted creations are exactly alike, it's our differences that make each of us one of a kind. We want our community to see themselves in these characters and feel something, so we created a world with as much personality as the people in it.”

Leaning into the charm of analog storytelling, the campaign brings a familiar tradition into the present with fresh imagination that celebrates human creativity and the joy of individuality. The creative choice is as intentional as the message itself:

- 72% of Americans saying nostalgic memories inspire them when life feels complicated*
- 68% of U.S. adults say nostalgia influences the products they purchase**

For e.l.f., embracing what makes us different isn't a seasonal message; it's an everyday commitment to celebrating individuality and inclusivity. e.l.f.’s high-quality, accessibly priced Holy Grail products put extra sparkle in the spot:

- Kit, the sentimental, nurturing presence holding the group together, preps with Power Grip Primer ($11)
- Echo, whose gift of gab knows no bounds, makes a statement with Glow Reviver Lip Oil ($9)
- Cleo, the bookish introvert with a talent all her own, gets her festive glow with Thirst Burst Drops ($13)

With his unmistakable Scottish voice and signature theatrical wit, **Alan Cumming** narrates the trio’s holiday adventure. “I do love a character with a little something extra, and Kit, Echo and Cleo each have plenty of that,” said **Cumming.** “What I love about this story is that their differences aren’t things to hide, they’re what make them special. Add in the incredible artistry of this handmade world, and it was a rather lovely holiday adventure to be part of.”

Directed by Cami Kwan, co-founder of Apartment D Films, the campaign is a deliberate celebration of analog artistry, where every playful detail is an example of hands-on craftsmanship. From individually molded characters to intricately constructed miniature sets, the production embraces the time-intensive process of traditional stop-motion animation, capturing the magic of a world built by hand, one frame at a time. In line with e.l.f.'s commitments to championing underrepresented artists and female empowerment, the production included women comprising 90% of the puppet team and 100% of the animation team.

**SHADOW,** a long-time creative marketing and communications agency partner to e.l.f. Beauty’s brands, led the campaign’s creative concept, script development and casting, working with Adam Goldman, Cumming's longtime collaborator, on the script.

The 60-second “e.l.f. Made to Stand Out” spot debuts November 2, 2026, across e.l.f. digital and social platforms. The holiday magic will extend beyond the screen and into the shopping aisle in a takeover of the TV sections of Best Buy and Target stores throughout the holiday gift-giving season.
